name: 情绪4周变化
scope: AAII survey representation, SPY 120 quote interval retrospective return information only

definition.formula: x[w]-x[w-4]，须w-4..w五个连续调查日历周均有恰一条有限值
definition.direction: 正值表示比四周前更乐观，不预设涨跌方向
definition.parameters: fixed 4 calendar week intervals, 5 surveys; not 4-row compression

input.adjustment: not_applicable_to_survey; target old adjusted close vintage unknown

universe.target: SPY USD broad US equity ETF
universe.missing: no forward fill, no missing-week compression; unknown durations remain missing

time.survey_week: Monday-Sunday; duplicate or unordered weeks error
time.observation: reported survey date, historical first release unknown
time.available_at: unknown; inherited date+7 days 23:59 is assumption only
time.decision_at: none; retrospective research; t first quote strictly after assumed date
time.timezone: America/New_York date-label semantics only, intraday precision unknown

validation.limitations: formula correctness does not establish historical first-release eligibility

registration: local research proposal, not a second global registry or approved LEI trigger

name: 连续看跌占优周数
scope: AAII survey representation, SPY 120 quote interval retrospective return information only

definition.formula: 本周x>=0则0；x<0且上一周已知连续值则上周计数+1；首条或缺周后x<0则未知，直到首次x>=0才重新有确定起点
definition.direction: 越大表示看跌比例超过看涨比例持续越久，不预设涨跌方向

input.adjustment: not_applicable_to_survey; target old adjusted close vintage unknown

universe.target: SPY USD broad US equity ETF

name: 退出极端悲观当周
scope: AAII survey representation, SPY 120 quote interval retrospective return information only

definition.formula: 1{x[w-1]<=-25 and x[w]>-25}；仅相邻两个连续调查周且值有限时返回0/1，否则缺失
definition.direction: 1表示本周刚离开原定义极端悲观，下一周不自动延续
definition.parameters: -25 percentage points from original threshold; equality remains extreme
